system.text:
Style · what changed from Nevma Music v3

• Same type, rules and motion: Montserrat Light tracked caps, Nunito Sans for reading, the cyan–magenta–yellow hairline, pill buttons, scroll reveals, press scale.
• Ground flips to Bone #ECE7DE with Paper #F5F2EC panels and Ink #0B0B0C text, so product photos read like an atelier, not a club. True black stays for drop moments (next-drop band, footer, announcement bar), where Style yellow #F0E81C is the only accent.
• Edition meter: five pips per piece, filled = still available. Words always sit next to the pips ("3 of 5 left", "Last piece", "Sold out").
• Small catalogue: 3 to 4 large pieces per drop, editorial rows instead of grids. Sold-out pieces stay visible and move to the archive.
• Header wordmark is set in type until NEVMA sends a one-colour dark logo; the real logo shows on black (footer).

rules.text:
Commerce rules shown in the designs (PROPOSED, to agree with NEVMA)

• Edition of five per colourway, across all sizes. Stock comes live from Shopify.
• One of each piece per customer.
• A bag does not hold a piece: whoever pays first gets it. Said plainly on product, bag and checkout.
• Every piece is numbered at packing (No. x of 5) and shown in the order.
• Members hear about drops by email first; the notify-me form works for guests too.
• Returns within 14 days; a returned piece goes back on sale.
• Prices in £ (London brand); Shopify Markets can add € later.
